steps.notice: New insurance terms: from now on a pallet, load included, may weigh at most 800 kg (was 1,000 kg).
After a near-miss we are lowering the indoor forklift speed limit to 8 km/h (was 10 km/h).
Our haulier switched to a lighter trailer fleet: trailer payload is now 22,000 kg (was 24,000 kg).
Shift supervisors may now approve damaged-goods write-offs up to 750 EUR; above that the warehouse manager approves (was 500 EUR).
With the new loading crew each outbound door now handles 4 trailer loads per shift (was 3).

contradictions.quote_a: Review every spill and damage event at shift handover and close all open quarantine records before the next shift starts.
contradictions.quote_b: Review open quarantine positions at each shift handover, carrying unresolved assessments forward with named owner and required completion time until closure.
contradictions.explanation: One section requires all quarantine records to be closed before the next shift, while the other requires unresolved quarantine assessments to be carried forward to the next shift.

contradictions.quote_a: cases needing write-off above 500 EUR stay locked until the warehouse manager signs off.
contradictions.quote_b: Any case needing write-off above 750 EUR is secured, documented and passed to the warehouse manager the same day.
contradictions.explanation: One section requires manager sign-off only above 750 EUR while the other requires it above 500 EUR, so both cannot be true for the same write-off threshold.

violations.quote: The warehouse manager owns operations, safety and inventory accuracy
violations.explanation: The fact states that stock controllers own inventory accuracy, not the warehouse manager.

violations.quote: with passing clearance for the widest 1,000 kg pallet.
violations.explanation: The fact caps a pallet including its load at at most 800 kg, not 1,000 kg.

violations.quote: cases needing write-off above 500 EUR stay locked until the warehouse manager signs off.
violations.explanation: The fact sets the threshold for warehouse-manager approval of damaged-goods write-offs at above 750 EUR, not 500 EUR.

violations.quote: Value-added packing is performed only at the Zone F workstations under PR-07 and PR-09.
violations.explanation: The fact states that PR-05 is titled Packing and labelling.
